Application scenarios: infant bedrooms, neonatal monitoring rooms, daycare institutions. The system monitors 24/7; once prone sleeping or mouth/nose occlusion is detected, it triggers a loud alarm and notifies parents via mobile. Skill features: prone sleeping and mouth/nose occlusion are the main environmental causes of SIDS.
